answers.answer: You receive 24 days of paid annual leave, 10 days of paid sick leave, and the company observes 12 paid public holidays each year, giving you a total of 46 paid days off annually [1][3][4]. Birthing parents also get 26 weeks of fully paid parental leave, while non-birthing parents receive 4 weeks of fully paid leave [6].
Yes—you may carry forward up to 8 unused annual leave days into the next calendar year, but they must be taken by 31 March or they will lapse[1].
Employees receive 10 days of paid sick leave per year [1].
You must provide a medical certificate (doctor’s note) if you are absent for more than 2 consecutive days, and you need to upload it to the HR portal within 7 days of returning to work [5].
Birthing parents receive 26 weeks of fully paid parental leave[1].
A new father (non-birthing parent) is entitled to 4 weeks of fully paid parental leave, which can be taken in up to two blocks within the first 12 months after the birth or adoption [1].
If you must work on a public holiday, you receive a compensatory day off that must be taken within 60 days [1].
You can request up to 30 days of unpaid leave per year [1].
The hotel reimbursement limit in metro cities is ₹6,000 per night [1].
You are reimbursed at ₹12 per kilometre for personal vehicle use [1].
No, you do not need receipts for meals while traveling on business; the ₹1,500 per-day per-diem for meals is provided without requiring receipts[1].
Alcoholic drinks are not reimbursable, except when purchased at an approved client event [1].
Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of the expense being incurred [1][2].
Yes. Remote employees get a one-time home-office allowance of ₹25,000 to cover a desk, chair and accessories [1].
Each employee receives an annual learning budget of ₹40,000 [1].

ERR-4021 indicates that the payment provider’s webhook did not reach the orders service within 30 seconds; you should first check the provider’s webhook dashboard for an outage, and if the provider is healthy, restart the webhook-consumer deployment with `kubectl rollout restart deploy/webhook-consumer -n payments` — missed webhooks will be replayed automatically every 15 minutes by the reconciliation job [1].
ERR-5310 means the API cannot obtain a database connection, indicating that the database connection pool is exhausted[1].
You must acknowledge a page within 5 minutes [2].
On-call engineers receive a stipend of ₹4,000 per week[1].
A SEV1 incident is when the product is down or data is at risk for all customers[1].
A blameless postmortem must be completed within 5 working days after the incident [1].
No—you should not manually replay missed payment webhooks; they are automatically replayed by the reconciliation job every 15 minutes. [1]

Run the restart command for the webhook-consumer deployment:

```bash
kubectl rollout restart deploy/webhook-consumer -n payments
```
